verdict.rationale: Mirrors documents an official SDK installed as an npm package, with prompt and capture hooks, so JS/TS instrumentation is covered. The pack names no Python SDK; listing mostly-Python frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, smolagents, Google ADK) only implies Python compatibility without documenting a supported Python package. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official Python SDK (package or install instructions), per-language API docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either SDK.
